Subject: Post-demo: model fit & quantization tradeoffs for Nebula - proposed eval plan

Hi Samira / Mike —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a concrete next step to make progress on fit/quality: we heard three priorities from your side:

- High precision on entity extraction and tabular-normalization across short and long contexts.
- Predictable 95th percentile latency under load for interactive workflows.
- No regressions on the existing high-priority prompt set (finance reconciliation).

Based on the call I sketched an initial evaluation axis and recommended model/quant families (very high level):

- Candidate models: Llama-3-70B-chat (float16 baseline), Llama-3-13B-instruct, and a smaller efficient option Redwood-Open-13B-8k.
- Quant strategies to test: AWQ (8-bit asymmetric) for best quality/cost balance, GPTQ (4/8-bit variants) for throughput extremes, and an FP8-like config for latency-critical tails (experimental).
- Key metrics: extraction F1 on your benchmark, hallucination rate (kb-linked testcases), token throughput @ 99ms p50/p95, and end-to-end error surface for the finance prompts.

Next step I propose: we run a two-week eval with your prompt set + 1k synthetic edge cases we mentioned. Redwood will spin up a dedicated eval pool, run AWQ and GPTQ variants, and attach a spreadsheet with per-prompt regressions. Deliverables: raw baseline (float16) scores, AWQ vs GPTQ deltas, and a recommended production config.

I attached the prompt set we discussed (nebula_prompts_v1.jsonl) and a blank bench template. Can you confirm the 2-week window starting Monday 7/20 works for you? Also confirm we have permission to run the synthetic edge-case generator against a sampled subset of your dataset (PII-safe, masked).

Regards,
Soojin

Soojin/Marissa —

Quick technical breakdown and proposed matrix we'll run (high level):

Matrix dims: model (Llama-3-70B / Llama-3-13B / Redwood-Open-13B-8k) x quant (float16 baseline / AWQ-8 / GPTQ-4 / GPTQ-8 / FP8-proxy) x context (1k / 4k tokens)

Estimated throughput & quality expectations (rough):
- Llama-3-70B float16: baseline quality, p50 token latency 18ms, p95 95ms (on our T4-equivalent eval pool).
- Llama-3-70B AWQ-8: ~1.8x throughput vs float16, quality drop ~1.5-3% absolute on extraction F1 in worst-case prompts.
- Llama-3-70B GPTQ-4: ~3.5x throughput, quality drop ~4-7% abs on tricky KB-linked cases (higher hallucination risk).
- Llama-3-13B AWQ-8: small quality delta (<1%), 2.2x throughput improvement — attractive middle ground for cost-sensitive flows.
- FP8-proxy (experimental): best latency tail improvements (p95 down by ~20%), but needs careful stability testing; not recommended for production-sensitive extraction yet.

Attachments: I exported a short slide (nebula_map_awq_vs_gptq.pdf) showing per-prompt F1 deltas and a sample cost table. We'll run the matrix on a small pilot (10% of prompt set) first to validate before full 2-week run.

Ask: Marissa, can you provision the Private runner for the pilot? If Private not available, we'll fall back to hosted with a signed attestation for PII masking.

—Aditya
